assertion.rationale: F1: data-api has ingressExternal:true and zero inbound authentication (app.ts:56) — anyone who finds the FQDN reads Defender posture, Dependabot alerts and Log Analytics results, and can loop full table scans. F2: the MCP auth gate is inert in the shipped configuration — it throws only in backendMode 'cloud', MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS is set nowhere in infra/ or .github/, so /healthz reports auth.enforced:false to anyone. F3: the Direct Line token endpoint mints tokens to unauthenticated callers whenever DIRECTLINE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset or Origin is absent, and that path carries the MCP token, making F2's gate irrelevant to it. F13: zero workload RBAC is expressed anywhere in IaC — the only role assignments in the estate are deployer-to-Owner and verifier-to-Reader, both at subscription scope in PowerShell; seven documented workload grants (data-api, mcp-tools, cost-ingest) exist nowhere as code, so access is not limited to authorized users, processes or devices by construction.

recommendation: Set ingressExternal:false on data-api (both frontends already proxy /api/ server-side). Invert the MCP auth gate default to enforced-unless-explicitly-opted-out, set MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS explicitly, and resolve the token via keyVaultUrl + UAMI rather than a secure param. Make the Direct Line endpoint refuse (500) when DIRECTLINE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset and refuse (403) when Origin is absent. Express the seven documented workload RBAC grants in IaC and add a criterion asserting each principal holds exactly its expected roles.
